newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong scouts make "world's longest" sushi roll.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong scouts make "world's longest" sushi roll.

text.p: Boy scouts in Hong Kong have produced what they claim is the world's longest Japanese sushi roll, measuring 108 metres (351 feet).
The giant roll was made of 80 kg (180 lb) of rice wrapped in 700 seaweed leaves and stuffed with 10 kg (22.5 lb) of carrots, a spokesman said. It was made at a district festival.
Sushi is a popular Japanese snack comprising seaweed wrapped around sticky rice with a variety of stuffings such as pickled vegetables or fish.
